meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会拉取仓库里全部 open 的 issue 和 PR，每条各起一个后台 quick 任务做只读分析，并把带 GitHub permalink 证据的报告写入 /tmp/{时间戳}/ 目录；它不在 GitHub 上做任何评论、合并、关闭或加标签。
howto.when: 当你说出 “triage”、“triage issues”、“triage PRs” 等触发词时接管，随后分析该仓库所有 open 条目。

say.note: 逐个分析所有 open issue，各写一份报告文件
只读分析所有 open PR，输出报告不改动

howto.what_en: Claude pulls every open issue and PR, spawns one background quick task per item for read-only analysis, and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. It never comments, merges, closes, or labels on GitHub.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "triage", "triage issues", or "triage PRs"; it then covers all open items in the repo.

say_en.note: Analyzes every open issue, one report file each
Read-only pass over all open PRs; writes reports
Covers issues and PRs together in one run
